title: Zoom desktop client data
whyItMatters: Zoom keeps local databases and logs for meetings, chat, contacts and settings. The folder shows which accounts and meetings were used on this PC.
source: Zoom Support, Clearing Zoom cache and cookies: Windows data folder %APPDATA%/Zoom - https://support.zoom.com/hc/en/article?id=zm_kb&sysparm_article=KB0058835
notes: Desktop client data. Local recordings are saved under Documents/Zoom by default and are outside this locator. No database or log is opened.

cleanup.exportFirst: Save any local recording, chat file or note you need; recordings usually live in Documents/Zoom.
cleanup.signOut: Sign out of Zoom on this PC and remove this device from the signed-in devices list in the Zoom web portal.
steps: Save the recordings and files you need.
Sign out of Zoom on this PC.
Uninstall Zoom from Settings > Apps > Installed apps.
Delete the Zoom folder named in the plan if it is still there.
cleanup.risk: Removes local Zoom meeting, chat and settings data from this PC. Cloud recordings and account data stay in the Zoom account.
cleanup.source: Zoom Support, Uninstalling and reinstalling the Zoom application: https://support.zoom.com/hc/en/article?id=zm_kb&sysparm_article=KB0065146
